description: ACCDB: Keyed 2-table INNER JOIN & LEFT JOIN dynaset Updatable, Edit (child & parent & join-key under default, dbConsistent=32, dbInconsistent=16), AddNew (child with existing parent & new parent), Delete (child vs unmatched LEFT JOIN row), plus unkeyed join non-updatable control. Keeps all pages.

args.text: CREATE TABLE P (PID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_P PRIMARY KEY, PName TEXT(20))
CREATE TABLE C (CID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_C PRIMARY KEY, PID LONG, CVal TEXT(20), CONSTRAINT FK_C_P FOREIGN KEY (PID) REFERENCES P (PID))
CREATE TABLE U1 (K LONG, V TEXT(10))
CREATE TABLE U2 (K LONG, W TEXT(10))
SELECT P.PID AS PPID, P.PName, C.CID, C.PID AS CPID, C.CVal FROM P INNER JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID ORDER BY C.CID
SELECT P.PID AS PPID, P.PName, C.CID, C.PID AS CPID, C.CVal FROM P INNER JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID ORDER BY C.CID
SELECT P.PID AS PPID, P.PName, C.CID, C.PID AS CPID, C.CVal FROM P INNER JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID ORDER BY C.CID
SELECT P.PID AS PPID, P.PName, C.CID, C.PID AS CPID, C.CVal FROM P LEFT JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID ORDER BY P.PID, C.CID
SELECT U1.K, U1.V, U2.W FROM U1 INNER JOIN U2 ON U1.K = U2.K
SELECT PID, PName FROM P ORDER BY PID
SELECT CID, PID, CVal FROM C ORDER BY CID
